operations.name: Arturo Gamboa

expected.name: Arturo Gamboa
expected.description: Arturo Gamboa was shot by an armed safety volunteer at the June 14, 2025 No Kings protest in Salt Lake City, Utah, after bringing a rifle to the demonstration. A bystander was killed by the volunteer’s gunfire. Police arrested Gamboa on suspicion of murder after he left the scene, although he did not fire his rifle. He remained jailed without formal charges until a judge ordered his release on June 20, 2025. Prosecutors later confirmed that no charges would be filed against him.

operations.source: https://npr.brightspotcdn.com/16/7a/fbf6a3084ec3986c361b22a939e6/document-42.pdf — Utah Third District Court affidavit of probable cause, page 1, explicitly identifies Arturo Roberto Gamboa and DOB January 29, 2001. Document also distinguishes June 14 arrest from June 15 booking. Only blank DOB filled; allegations are not imported as established conduct. Existing biography records subsequent release and no charges.
